1879484594.name: Gondren
1879484594.desc: An early endeavour in the craft of ring-making made prior to the forging of the rings of power, this unique device possesses great strength nevertheless. Such rings have appeared on occasion throughout the history of Middle-earth, seemingly never staying with one master for long. This artifact is one of the few powers that might counter the strength of the greater rings, if only for a little while.
